svg.text: One agent connection per account: grant, binding, request
PXLBLZ owns
standard MCP OAuth
one edit
grant
account + client
OAuth consent once, in the browser signed in as the author.
Token on every MCP request. Ends: Revoke from any window, expiry.
Says which account. Cannot say which window or Show.
binding
window + Show
one per account
Connect in the Show's agent panel arms this window; the first call claims it.
Every routed command re-checks account, editor instance, Show, scope.
Ends: leave the Show, reload, close, Release, Revoke, stale expiry.
A dropped MCP stream is not the binding. A second agent is refused by name.
request
operation id
begin_edit captures context and base revision; commit_edit is admitted once.
Ends: applied, refused (stale, gone), cancelled, retired. Duplicates return the original.
Cancel wins only before the application boundary; after that, Undo.
revoking a grant ends its binding and unapplied requests; releasing retires them; nothing replays
